title: Assigned Repair Payments: Deductible by Cause of Loss and Garaging State
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the deductible an assigned repair payment carries follows the cause of the loss recorded on the claim report, as follows:
- **Glass loss, zero-deductible state.** A glass loss on a vehicle whose owner term is garaged in one of the package's windshield zero-deductible states carries no deductible.
- **Any other comprehensive cause.** Any other comprehensive cause carries the package's comprehensive deductible. This includes a glass loss garaged in any other state.
- **Collision cause.** A collision cause carries the package's collision deductible.

The garaging state is the one recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term the coverage belongs to. Florida is the windshield zero-deductible state of every package.

### Decision table

| Cause recorded on the claim report | Owner Auto Policy term garaged in Florida | Garaged in Virginia, Texas, Georgia, Arizona or Ohio |
|---|---|---|
| Glass | No deductible | Package's comprehensive deductible |
| Theft, weather, animal, fire or vandalism | Package's comprehensive deductible | Package's comprehensive deductible |
| Collision with another vehicle, or single-vehicle collision | Package's collision deductible | Package's collision deductible |

### Package figures (USD)

| Package | Comprehensive | Collision |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 2500 | 2500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 2000 | 2000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 1500 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1000 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 500 | 500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 250 | 500 |

### Hypothetical cases

- A cracked windshield replaced on a Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible vehicle garaged in Florida carries no deductible. The same loss garaged in Ohio carries 250 USD.
- An animal strike on that vehicle carries 250 USD. A single-vehicle collision carries 500 USD.
